scripts.title: Auto File Organizer
scripts.description: Automatically sort files in your Downloads folder by extension into organized subfolders
scripts.useCase: Perfect for keeping your Downloads folder clean. Runs in background and organizes files as you download them.
scripts.setupInstructions:
1. Download the .bat file
2. Right-click and select 'Run as Administrator'
3. Edit the 'source_path' variable in the script to point to your Downloads folder
4. Schedule it in Task Scheduler to run every hour

scripts.title: System Cleanup Pro
scripts.description: Advanced PowerShell script to clean temporary files, clear DNS cache, and optimize Windows performance
scripts.useCase: Use this monthly to keep your Windows system clean and fast. Removes junk files that built-in cleanup tools miss.
scripts.setupInstructions:
1. Right-click PowerShell and select 'Run as Administrator'
2. Navigate to the script location: cd C:\Scripts
3. Run: Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
4. Execute: .\system_cleanup.ps1
scripts.code:
# System Cleanup Pro - PowerShell Script
# Run as Administrator

Write-Host "Starting System Cleanup..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Clear Windows Temp Files
Write-Host "Cleaning temp files..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\Windows\Temp" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -Recurse
Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -Recurse

# Clear DNS Cache
Write-Host "Clearing DNS cache..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
ipconfig /flushdns

# Clear Recycle Bin
Write-Host "Emptying recycle bin..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Clean Windows Update Cache
Write-Host "Cleaning Windows Update cache..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Stop-Service wuauserv -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service wuauserv

# Optimize Drives
Write-Host "Optimizing drives..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Optimize-Volume -DriveLetter C -Defrag -Verbose

Write-Host "Cleanup Complete!" -ForegroundColor Green
Read-Host "Press Enter to exit"

scripts.title: Batch Video Converter
scripts.description: Python script to convert entire folders of videos to different formats using FFmpeg
scripts.useCase: Convert hundreds of videos at once. Perfect for content creators who need to optimize footage for web or social media.
scripts.setupInstructions:
1. Install Python 3.8+
2. Install FFmpeg and add to PATH
3. Install required library: pip install tqdm
4. Run: python video_converter.py
5. Follow the prompts to select input/output folders
scripts.code:
import os
import subprocess
from tqdm import tqdm
from pathlib import Path

class VideoConverter:
    def __init__(self, input_folder, output_folder, output_format='mp4'):
        self.input_folder = Path(input_folder)
        self.output_folder = Path(output_folder)
        self.output_format = output_format
        self.output_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    def convert_video(self, video_path):
        """Convert single video file"""
        output_path = self.output_folder / f"{video_path.stem}.{self.output_format}"
        
        cmd = [
            'ffmpeg', '-i', str(video_path),
            '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'fast', '-crf', '23',
            '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '128k',
            '-y',  # Overwrite output
            str(output_path)
        ]
        
        subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        return output_path
    
    def batch_convert(self):
        """Convert all videos in folder"""
        video_extensions = ['.mp4', '.avi', '.mkv', '.mov', '.wmv', '.flv']
        video_files = [
            f for f in self.input_folder.iterdir() 
            if f.suffix.lower() in video_extensions
        ]
        
        print(f"Found {len(video_files)} videos to convert")
        
        for video_file in tqdm(video_files, desc="Converting"):
            try:
                output = self.convert_video(video_file)
                print(f"✓ Converted: {output.name}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"✗ Failed {video_file.name}: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    converter = VideoConverter(
        input_folder="./input_videos",
        output_folder="./output_videos",
        output_format="mp4"
    )
    converter.batch_convert()

scripts.title: Network Reset Tool
scripts.description: Quick command-line tool to reset network adapters, flush DNS, and fix common connectivity issues
scripts.useCase: When your internet is acting up, run this instead of manually typing 10 different commands. Fixes 90% of common network issues.
scripts.setupInstructions:
1. Right-click the .bat file
2. Select 'Run as Administrator'
3. Wait for all commands to complete
4. Restart your computer when prompted
scripts.code:
@echo off
echo ========================================
echo    NETWORK RESET TOOL
echo ========================================
echo.

echo [1/6] Releasing IP address...
ipconfig /release

echo [2/6] Renewing IP address...
ipconfig /renew

echo [3/6] Flushing DNS cache...
ipconfig /flushdns

echo [4/6] Resetting Winsock...
netsh winsock reset

echo [5/6] Resetting TCP/IP...
netsh int ip reset

echo [6/6] Resetting network adapters...
netsh advfirewall reset

echo.
echo ========================================
echo    COMPLETE!
echo ========================================
echo.
echo Please restart your computer for changes to take effect.
echo.
pause
